keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Ivan Sunjic (Pafos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
David Goldar (Pafos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Pafos 0, Midtjylland 1. Mileta Rajovic (Midtjylland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Abdou Aziz Ndiaye.
Substitution, Pafos. Alexandre Brito replaces Pêpê Rodrigues.
Substitution, Pafos. Murad Mammadov replaces Ivan Sunjic.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Ousmane Diao replaces Abdou Aziz Ndiaye.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Mikael Uhre replaces Friday Etim.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Martin Erlic replaces Hong Hyun-Seok.
Delay in match because of an injury Murad Mammadov (Pafos).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Mikel Gogorza replaces Mileta Rajovic.
Pedro Bravo (Midtjylland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Mikael Uhre (Midtjylland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Pafos. Biel replaces João Correia.
Substitution, Pafos. Domingos Quina replaces David Goldar.
Goal! Pafos 0, Midtjylland 2. Mikel Gogorza (Midtjylland) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Pafos. Guga replaces Vlad Dragomir.
Substitution, Midtjylland. Stanley Iheanacho replaces Julius Emefile.
Alexandre Brito (Pafos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
